title: Mjölnir deployment mode (ADR 0008)
description: Deployment mode is a declared, machine-readable state, not a promise in a document. The enum is closed and versioned; an unknown value is a CONFIG_ERROR, never a silent fallback to permissive; and an unset mode is LOCAL_ONLY. A LOCAL_ONLY process refuses hosted code paths structurally — the hosted client is never constructed — so the refusal cannot be forgotten by a later edit.

mode.description: An unknown value MUST fail as CONFIG_ERROR. Falling back to CLOUD on an unparseable value would make a typo a privacy incident.

allowsHosted.description: Derived from `mode`, published so a consumer can render the refusal without re-implementing the rule.

egressDeclarations.description: Every capability that can egress must declare its egress footprint. A capability with an egress footprint and no declaration is a registry error, because "what leaves the machine" is otherwise unknowable per action rather than per product.

then.description: Local-only and air-gapped modes may not reach hosted code paths at all.
